articles.title: Gene conversion empowers natural selection in a clonal fish species
articles.summary: A 2015 study by Speijer, Luke, and Eliá, published in PNAS, underscores the fundamental role of sex in eukaryotic life. The research posits that sexual reproduction is not merely common but an ancient, ubiquitous, and inherent characteristic of all eukaryotic organisms. This highlights its critical, foundational importance in the evolution and diversity of complex life forms on Earth.
